title: The Coros Dura 2, Spooky Bike Stories, and Cycling’s Jorts Problem
content:
We headed into the desert and it turned out it's hot. We talk about crazy winds and surviving the heat just to get to the climbs. Plus, answering your questions on aero math and looking at the new Garmin Edge 1060.

Read the full article at The Coros Dura 2, Spooky Bike Stories, and Cycling’s Jorts Problem on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
